answers.core: Many people creating a new Godot project with git for VCS will start with this `.gitignore` file, so it's not wrong to improve it a bit.
answers.workaround: One can just change the `.gitignore` file themselves, it's not really a big problem. It's just an inconsistency.

title: Change `.godot/` to `/.godot/` in `.gitignore` template to be consistent with `/android/`
